English | [简体中文](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX/blob/main/CHANGELOG_ZH-CN.md)

Build `11140102`.

### Added

- App Audio Library: replace notification sounds with custom audio. Apps not shown in the list can use the capture guide to obtain their notification-sound paths.
- Pairing & Device Connection: used to obtain required paths.

### Changed

- Case-insensitive cache UUID comparison (#131)
- Reject trailing text in date fields (#132)
- Share-inbox fallback (#133)
- Validate backup metadata filenames (#134)
- Reduce cache descriptor string-scan allocations (#135)
- Reuse one preview snapshot for field search (#136)
- Preserve field edits over layout presets (#137)
- Preserve existing plist keys when editing fields (#138)
- Reduce allocations in exact plist comparisons (#139)
- Traverse document differences once (#140)
- Fix Face ID failing after enabling Apple Intelligence (#128)
- Add missing localization for #128 (#146)
- Pairing paths are migrated when a reinstall moves the app data container.

### Fixed

- Fix pairing failure in side-loaded release builds.
- Add the missing Face ID recovery localization strings.
- Fix audio file selection in side-loaded builds.
- Refresh captured sounds immediately and cache the app audio list.
- Show LocalDevVPN guidance and stop capture when the tunnel does not connect.

## WrapPin 1.0.26（Build 96）

- **当前模拟目标** · 固定模拟时，地图单独标出当前目标。选中其他地点后，点「查看模拟位置」可以回到当前目标。#57
- **精确选点** · 打开地图上的准星按钮，拖动地图或用摇杆微调。点「确认选点」后，再点「开始模拟定位」或「更换模拟位置」应用坐标。#58 #59
- **选点面板** · 地点标题、收藏和清除按钮固定在面板上方。空间不足时可以滚动下方选项。
- **收藏重命名** · 在「收藏与历史」里点收藏旁的铅笔，改名后保留原坐标和地址。#61

### 安装

- **Standard** · 使用 SideStore 等工具签装，运行时使用兼容的外部设备隧道。
- **Tunnel** · 主 App 和内置扩展都需要支持 Packet Tunnel 的签名配置。

两版均为未签名 IPA，支持 iOS/iPadOS 18.0 及以上。覆盖升级时使用原版本类型和签名身份。[安装说明](https://github.com/suversal/WrapPin/blob/v1.0.26/Documentation/Installation.zh-CN.md)

apps.name: Nestvane
apps.subtitle: Android 17 running inside an iOS app, without JIT
apps.localizedDescription: Android 17 running inside an iOS app, without JIT.
apps.versionDescription:
Android 17 inside an iPhone or iPad app, with no JIT and no jailbreak. Version 1.12 adds two things asked for in [#5](https://github.com/atomsprout/nestvane/issues/5): a backup of the whole Android, and the official KernelSU Manager.

**Nestvane is still for developers only.** The only way to run it is to sign the IPA with a paid Apple Developer Program membership (US$99 a year) and sideload it.

## New in 1.12

- **Back up and restore Android** (#5, item 12). Two new items in the More menu. **Back Up Android…** stops Android, saves its apps, their data, its settings and your root answers in one file, and lets you choose where to keep it; Android then starts again. **Restore Android…** puts a backup you choose in place and starts Android from it. What Android had before is kept until Android reaches its home screen from the backup, and put back if it does not get there. The shared folder (On My iPhone → Nestvane → Android) is not in the backup: it is in the Files app already. On an iPhone 14, 507 MB of Android data made a 331 MB backup, and restoring it took under a second. An iPhone backup already includes Android's data; this is for going back to a moment (before trying something with root, say) or for moving only Android.
- **KernelSU Manager** (#5, item 5). With root turned on in Nestvane's Settings, the official KernelSU Manager (3.3.1, from [KernelSU's releases](https://github.com/tiann/KernelSU/releases)) shows KernelSU as **Working**, lists your apps, and its switch for each app allows or refuses root. Its answers and the ones you give in the iOS prompt are the same answers: change one and the other shows it. Only the Manager signed by KernelSU is recognized. KernelSU's driver is answered by Nestvane's own kernel layer; no KernelSU code is in Nestvane. Download the Manager yourself and install it as any APK.

apps.name: WQ Files
apps.subtitle: File manager for iOS 26 and 27 (worse_query)
apps.localizedDescription:
File browser, app data manager and cache cleaner for iOS 26 and 27, built on the worse_query sandbox technique. No jailbreak and no kernel exploit.

• Browse every app's data container, app groups, extension and daemon containers
• Plist editor and hex viewer/editor; edits are backed up first
• Select, move across apps, compress and extract ZIPs; import files and whole folders
• Syntax highlighting, SQLite viewer and media player
• Back up, restore and clear app data; AirDrop backups as ZIP
• Cache cleaner

iOS 26 and 27 (tested on 26.7.1, 27.0.1 and 27.2.1; on iOS 26, System Data and System Groups are not available). Needs a signer that keeps the App Group entitlement (AltStore, SideStore or Impactor; not Sideloadly).

versions.localizedDescription: Imports Apps Manager backups (.adbk), says when another app is using a file instead of showing errno 35, and keeps an app's database and its -wal/-shm files together.

Optional App Store icons for other apps (Settings → App Store Icons), fixes apps with one-word bundle ids (like Pinterest) and the empty gap above the Apps list on iOS 27, and keeps the Backups tab working on iOS 27 beta 5.
Custom inspectors (read-only JavaScript, install from a .zip), your own folders and files in the Cache Cleaner, and Japanese.
Fixes LiveContainer setups where every folder was refused, SQLite restore with -wal files, lossless SQLite and plist edits, and backups listed newest first.
Works inside LiveContainer again. Cache Cleaner: Clean is ready after a scan, plus Invert Selection. Wi-Fi uploads stop with sharing.
Recognizes iOS 27.3 beta 2+, where Apple patched worse_query. The access cache repairs itself when another app in the App Group broke it.
Show Folder Sizes, empty folder hints, Colored Cards with a pickable color, themed tiles; WQ Files is back in the Files app; fixes wrong app names on iOS 26.5 and the Crash Logs note.
Apps and Cache Cleaner scans are fast again (more than twice as fast as 0.9.11 and 0.9.12).
Wi-Fi Sharing: browse, download and upload files from any browser on the same Wi-Fi. Themes with importable .wqtheme files, Recent folders and files, progress bars, and a fix for a frozen screen.
Vietnamese translation. Apps and Clean scans keep running across tabs and app restarts, with Pause/Resume and a spinner or clock in the tab bar.
Fixes installed apps missing from Apps, App Data and Extension Data (e.g. on iOS 26.5).
App Groups now show their names on iOS 27.2+. Plain Background option, dark and tinted app icon, files you can't open are dimmed, and a clear notice on iOS 18 and older.
Reset Access Cache is now in Settings → Troubleshooting (both designs). The Log explains why access is blocked and logs a repeated failure only once.

New design: Home with container cards, tabs for Apps, Clean and Backups, Settings behind the gear. The previous design stays available (Settings → New Design). New screens translated into every language.

New: Search Inside Folders, Largest Files, Get Info, Duplicate, Copy to Folder, Favorites, Reopen Last Folder, update notice, Extract and Open for ZIPs, Thai. Safer SQLite save and app restore. Fixed: app backups could come out empty; app names and missing app folders on iOS versions with an unknown app database layout.

New: iOS 27.3 beta, Turkish, flags in the language list, Replace All when importing several files, Rename in Select, restore edited backups. Many safety fixes from a code review (folder delete, SQLite backups, ZIP, hex and plist editors, media).

New: delete folders with everything in them (backed up, restorable), Polish and Russian, filters in App Data, version in the device strip, Reset Access Cache. Fixed: backups with sockets, Share as ZIP of app folders, app names.
New: startup check (stops with what failed instead of empty lists when access breaks), Recently Deleted under Backups. Cache Cleaner progress bar.
New: edit SQLite databases (Edit, then Save writes back with a backup and integrity check). Korean translation. Fixed: Arabic corrections, empty app lists after an iOS update.

Now in Simplified Chinese, Arabic, German, Italian and Spanish, with a Language setting. New: Import as Backup, Keep Data Before Restore, media streams instead of copying, offloaded apps and App Bundles (iOS 27). Apps and the Cache Cleaner reopen instantly.

Select, move across apps, compress and extract ZIPs; import several files or whole folders. New: syntax highlighting, media player, Apps filter, bundle IDs and Copy Bundle ID, restore from App Backups, Allow Deleting and Show Item Counts settings. Fixed: iOS 26.5 app list, deleting locked files. Signing: use AltStore, SideStore or Impactor (Sideloadly drops the App Group).

Apps show up in seconds on every iOS version (no more long first scan); full scans only when needed and after you agree. New: sorting, A–Z sidebar, read-only SQLite viewer, swipe to delete, signing check at launch. Preliminary iOS 26 support.
iOS 27.2: app names are back. iOS 26 (26.0 – 26.7.2) is supported. Faster scans that are remembered, swipe to delete in the file browser, and a more detailed Log.
Cooler, faster scans (one shared pass, fewer cores); manage and delete backups, stop a cache clean, cancel ZIP exports; checked backups and restores; signing help in the README. Requires iOS 27.
AltStore/SideStore source; safer saves and restores (rollback, interrupted-restore recovery, no overwriting changed files); Log shows version, device and iOS.
Plist editor, hex viewer/editor, Open As, search bar, Home button, readable paths.
Safer backups and restores; large files are streamed.
Fixed: apps you installed were missing.
First release.

apps.name: INSAV
apps.subtitle: insav 原生 iOS 客户端
apps.localizedDescription: INSAV 是 insav 的第三方原生 iOS 客户端（SwiftUI，iOS 16+，iPhone / iPad 通用）。四个站点（主站 / 无码站 / 动漫站 / 4K 站）完整适配，浏览 / 搜索 / 系统原生播放（画中画、AirPlay）/ 外部播放器 / 整部下载离线观看 / 登录、收藏、订阅。安装包是未签名的，由商店用你自己的 Apple ID 签名。

versions.localizedDescription:
• 修复无码站打不开：无码站的域名会不定期更换，原来的自动发现方式已经失效，导致一直连不上；现在改成每次从官方的跳转页现取最新域名，换域名也能自动跟上，发现不了时提示里会说清楚卡在哪一步
• 其余功能同 1.3.0 (5)

• 新增外部字幕：详情页的圆按钮行里多了「字幕」按钮（主站和无码站的片才有，4K 站和动漫站没有番号，没有这个按钮）。点开按番号去外部字幕库搜，选一份马上显示在画面上，可以调同步（提前 / 延后 0.5 秒、5 秒）；选过的字幕下次打开同一部片自动用，不用再搜
• 下载时会把选好的字幕一起存：离线播放也有字幕；存到「文件」App 的下载，成品旁边还会放一份同名 .srt，Infuse、VLC 这类播放器会自动识别
• 用 SenPlayer、Lumenic、Infuse 播放时，自动带上选好的字幕（它们读的是原字幕文件，不带这里调的同步）
• 搜字幕只会把番号发给外部字幕库，别的信息不发；只在打开字幕面板时才搜
• 其余功能同 1.2.0 (4)

• 新增 4 个外部片源（选站页「更多片源」里）：各有栏目首页、搜索、详情和多线路播放，收藏和播放进度存在本机；暂时不支持下载和字幕
• 新增聚合搜索：同一个关键词同时搜所有站点和片源，按来源分组显示
• 外部播放器新增 Lumenic；Lumenic 和 SenPlayer 播放需要请求头的线路时会自动带上
• 选站页重新排版；「我的」页改成短列表，设置点进去再看，「刷新令牌」放在最上面
• 修复 VIP 令牌源在跨日 / 跨月后一直提示「正在续期」的问题（旧版本从 11 月 10 日起会遇到，升级后自动恢复）；去掉已经不再维护的第二个令牌源
• 界面上的说明文字更简短
• 其余功能同 1.0.0 (3)

• 下载：新增「App 内下载」——片子存进「文件」App（我的 iPhone → INSAV），下完自动转成 MP4，可以直接预览，也能交给 Infuse、VLC 这类播放器；转不了或空间不够时保留原文件，设置里可以关掉自动转换。「下载方式」选「自动」时，这台设备上系统的后台下载用不了就自动改用它（要保持 App 在前台）
• 下载失败时说清楚原因，失败的那一行可以复制诊断信息
• 详情页新增「线路检测」按钮（在收藏、下载旁边）：播不了或很慢时，一键看是站点接口、VIP 令牌源还是视频服务器哪一段不通
• VIP 内容：每次点播放都先取最新的令牌；「我的 → VIP 令牌源」里可以立即刷新，并显示每个源的结果
• 修正了「用 VidHub 播放」的跳转
• 其余功能同 build 2

• 换了新图标，桌面显示名改成 INSAV
• 下载：调大了下载的连接数（实际速度看网络）；下好的片子在「我的 → 下载」里离线播放
• 详情里没有真实字幕文件的条目，不再白请求一次字幕
• 其余功能同 build 1：四个站点完整适配、浏览 / 搜索、内置和外部播放器、登录 / 收藏 / 订阅 / 兑换码

• 首个版本：四个站点（主站、无码站、动漫站、4K 站）完整适配，启动时选站点，进去之后顶栏一键切换
• 浏览、搜索、演员 / 片商 / 主题、影评；内置播放器（画中画、字幕）和外部播放器
• 下载：详情页一键下载整部片，之后不联网也能看（离线文件只能在 App 里播放）
• 登录 / 注册、收藏、订阅、兑换码

apps.name: Erosion-CN
apps.subtitle: iOS / iPadOS 系统配置与 MobileGestalt 研究工具箱（中英双语）
apps.localizedDescription:
Erosion-CN 是面向 iOS / iPadOS 27.0–27.2.1 & 27.3 beta 1（及 26.x 部分功能）的中英双语系统配置与 MobileGestalt 研究工具箱（防白苹果安全加固版）。

• 原位覆盖写入（pwrite + F_FULLFSYNC）与写后全量读回校验，杜绝重启反弹与 0 字节白苹果
• 无损 CoreFoundation 类型直通，根治相机取景黑屏
• 运行时动态解析 libMobileGestalt.dylib 槽位 + 双金库 SHA-256 备份一键恢复原厂
• 支持国行 Apple 智能解锁、海外 eSIM 与 FaceTime 音频开启、应用存档备份、缓存清理与电池/崩溃诊断

⚠️ 签名要求：安装时请务必保留 App Group 权限（SideStore / AltStore / Feather 默认支持）。

Bilingual (English + Simplified Chinese) bootloop-hardened MobileGestalt & cross-container research toolkit for iOS/iPadOS 27.x. Requires at least one App Group entitlement when signing.

---

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **Fixed Unresponsive "Clean Selected" in Container Cache Cleaner (`CacheCleanerView`) / 修复容器缓存「一键清理已选」不生效** *(Thanks to [@KindLin99](https://github.com/KindLin99) for reporting [#53](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/53) / 感谢 [@KindLin99](https://github.com/KindLin99) 反馈 [#53](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/53))*
   - **Separated Button Styles in Overview Card**：Assigned `.borderless` to **Rescan** (`重新扫描`) and promoted **Clean Selected** (`一键清理已选`) to a full-width `.borderedProminent` button snapshotting targets prior to confirmation, eliminating SwiftUI `List` multi-button tap hijacking.
   - **Prevented Row Hit-Box Hijacking**：Replaced inline `NavigationLink` on **Inspect** (`查看`) with a `.borderless` button + `.navigationDestination(item:)` so tapping row checkboxes or **Clean** (`清理`) never triggers accidental navigation.
   - **Ad-Sentinel Protection & Re-Sized Refresh**：Unified scan/purge traversal depth (`Library/Caches` depth `7`, `tmp` depth `6`), skipped `.erosion_adlock` anti-recreate ad folders during cleanup, and updated remaining bytes / auth failure reporting accurately after purge.

2. **Explicit Read-Only & Sentinel State in `InfoViewer` / 文件详情页只读与防重建状态提示**
   - When a directory or file is already at `0555` / `0444`, the **Set Read-Only** preset button now automatically disables and displays `Already Read-Only` (`当前已是只读锁死状态`) or `Read-Only & Sentinel Active` (`当前已是只读防重建锁死状态`) alongside an `Anti-Recreate Lock` row (`Active (.erosion_adlock)`).
   - **Restore Read-Write** and **Apply** buttons disable when permissions already match, and restoring write permission on a sentinel directory from `InfoViewer` cleanly unlinks `.erosion_adlock`.

3. **Target Highlighting & Auto-Scroll on Ad Locator (`FileBrowserView` / `AdCacheBlockerView`) / 去广告「定位」自动高亮与居中定位**
   - Tapping **Locate** (`定位`) in Splash Ad Blocker now highlights the target ad folder/config inside its parent directory and scrolls smoothly to center it, with read-only sandbox grants for locator browsing and container grants ordered prior to `lstat` attribute checks.

## Erosion-CN v1.0.3 (Build 28)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **System Compatibility / 系统兼容性提示**  
> - **Supported / 完整支持**: `iOS / iPadOS 27.0 – 27.2.1` and `27.3 beta 1` (`24C503*`).  
> - **Patched / 已封堵**: Apple patched `worse_query` starting in **`iOS 27.3 beta 2` (`24C5049d+`)**. Do **NOT** update past `27.3 beta 1` if you rely on Erosion-CN.

---

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **Anti-Recreate Sentinel Lock (`0555` + `0444` `.erosion_adlock`) / 防重建占位锁加固**
   - Locking an ad directory now wipes existing ad files, places a 0-byte `0444` read-only sentinel file (`.erosion_adlock`) inside, and sets `0555` on the directory so ad SDKs cannot remove an empty `0555` folder and recreate a fresh `0755` folder under writable parent directories.
   - Unlocking (`0755`) removes `.erosion_adlock` automatically, and legacy weak `0555` locks show a one-tap **Harden** (`加固防重建`) action.

2. **`AppGroup` Shared Container Scan & Standalone Ad Config File Lock + Preview / 共享组扫描与单文件配置锁死预览**
   - Extends scanning to `/var/mobile/Containers/Shared/AppGroup` (automatically skipping system & proxy client groups).
   - Recognizes standalone splash/ad config files (`splash_ad.json`, `splash_ad.plist`, `launch_ad.*`, etc.) with inline **Preview** (`PlistViewer` / `TextViewer`) and safe in-place empty JSON/Plist overwrite + `0444` locking.

3. **Custom Watch List (`+` & File Browser Long-Press) / 自定义广告路径收藏**
   - Add custom ad folders or config files via the top-right **`+`** button or by long-pressing any eligible item in File Browser → **Add to Ad Blocker** (`加入广告锁死列表`), strictly enforcing safety guards against system directories, container roots, `Downloads`, symlinks, and core app preference plists.

4. **Boundary & Network Pairing Guidance / 生效边界与搭配建议**
   - Added a dedicated notice card inside `Splash Ad Blocker` reminding users that local directory/config locking stops disk caching while live ad network requests still fire — pairing with proxy ad-blocking rules (Surge / Quantumult X / Loon / Stash / Shadowrocket, etc.) gives complete coverage.

> 📜 Full changelog / 完整更新日志：**[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)** · User Guide / 使用指南：**[USAGE_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/USAGE_GUIDE.md)**

---

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **Per-App Splash Ad Cache Blocker (`chmod`) / 开屏广告缓存精准锁死 (`AdCacheBlockerView`)**
   - Added **「开屏广告缓存精准锁死 / Splash Ad Cache Blocker」** quick entries under **Tweaks → App Saves & Cleanup** (`功能修改 → 应用存档与空间清理`) and **File Browser → Quick Access** (`文件浏览 → 快捷访问`).
   - Combines curated per-app splash-ad paths (Weibo, Zhihu, NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, Taobao/Idlefish, JD, Meituan/Dianping, Amap, Baidu/Tieba/Netdisk, Ximalaya, Hupu, Douban) with shallow POSIX SDK detection (`KSAdSDK`, `BUAdSDK`/`Pangle`, `GDTMobSDK`/`TADCache`, `BaiduMobAd`, `SplashAd`, `LaunchAd`, etc.) — strictly excluding `SplashBoard`, WebKit, Cookies, `Downloads`, container roots, and symlinks.

apps.name: Andarium
apps.subtitle: Android on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Andarium runs the Android system on iPhone and iPad. It is built on the Kernarium runtime, which runs a real Linux kernel natively and emulates only the code of the apps, with graphics drawn through Metal.

It needs iOS 26 or later. With a free Apple ID, Android gets less memory. JIT is optional and experimental.

versions.localizedDescription:
New: root access with Magisk, Android's system libraries translated ahead of time, 120 Hz on ProMotion devices, Add to Home Screen, VoiceOver support, a frame rate that drops only when the device is very hot, text messages you write, and a notice when a newer version is out.

Fixed: Wi-Fi dropping when you return to Andarium, face scans in some apps that use the front camera, connections hanging after a move from Wi-Fi to cellular data, apps failing to reach servers after the network returns. VP9 videos now play with the hardware decoder.

apps.name: SideInstaller
apps.subtitle: An an app that installs Sidestore on iOS 27, fully on-device
apps.localizedDescription: Install SideStore and LiveContainer directly on your iPhone. No PC required.
apps.versionDescription:
# Added

* JIT. Please keep SideInstaller in the background to keep JIT running
* Sources. Add an AltStore-format source as an https link, an altstore:// or sidestore:// link, or a .json file. Thanks to @TinusTK (#143).
* Shortcuts actions, such as location spoofing, app installing and app refreshing.
* Pairing compatibility with ARMSX3


# Fixed

* Sign-in reports a current Mac again. 2.1.1 signed in as a Mac on macOS 10.15.7. Apple sometimes answers that Mac with a text-message code it never sends, or with -22410 or -23782. SideInstaller now signs in as the macOS 26.6 Mac it used up to 2.1.0, spelled \"Mac OS X\", and that Mac gets the code on trusted devices. The first sign-in with a password makes a new anisette identity, so Apple may ask for a code one more time.
* SideStore gets client info Apple lets through. Since 20 November Apple has answered SideStore's default client info with HTTP 503 (SideStore #1745). After installing SideStore, SideInstaller now sets it to the same Mac, spelled \"Mac OS X\". If SideStore then fails with -22410, open its Settings › User Customizations, tick \"Keep header customizations\" and tap Reset adi.pb.

apps.name: Nightflix
apps.subtitle: An iOS movie and series streaming app
apps.versionDescription:
Nightflix 3.0 is a complete redesign.

- New Netflix-style interface: Home with Series / Films / Categories filters, a featured title, Top 10 rows, Continue Watching and "Because You Watched" rows
- New & Hot tab: Coming Soon with release reminders, Everyone's Watching, and today's Top 10 series and films
- My Nightflix tab: Continue Watching, My List, titles you've rated, reminders and recently watched
- Tap a title for a quick preview, or open its full page with episodes, More Like This and trailers
- Search also finds titles by actor
- New built-in player (VidFast) with resume and episode autoplay
- The player opens in landscape and plays sound even with the silent switch on
